name: session-title-stamp
description: Preview or refresh the current chat title with a verified creation date, category and topic.

interface.longDescription: Preview or refresh the current chat title as creation date | category | topic. Supports Chinese and English categories, local or specified time zones, and MMDD or YYYYMMDD dates. Includes a compatibility check. Renaming requires official current-chat read/write tools in the desktop host; where unavailable, the skill explains the limitation and can suggest topic/category text. Requires Python 3.9+ and local execution. No background renaming, hooks, bulk access, external service, or telemetry.
defaultPrompt: Preview a dated title for this chat.
刷新当前聊天标题，使用上海时区。
Check whether title renaming is available in this chat.

publication.release_notes: Adds a read-only local diagnostic command and GitHub installation, update and troubleshooting documentation.
